rationale: Although price has slipped slightly below the 5m 9-EMA ($27.66) to $27.61, the pullback occurred on very light 1-minute volume (under 10k shares per bar) while the broader market is beginning to recover from its lows (SPY up from -3.98% at entry to -3.50%).
